title: Bounded dependency-security repair: transitive nanoid 3.3.17 -> 3.3.18 (GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8; closes B-019) under the normal policy, no age waiver - D-015
objective: Owner-authorized (D-015, 2026-08-18) minimal upgrade of the transitive nanoid resolution in apps/web/package-lock.json from exactly 3.3.17 to exactly 3.3.18, the first patched version for GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 (high: custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero; dependency path postcss -> nanoid ^3.3.16). Reconciled facts: 3.3.18 published 2026-08-07T16:41:05.696Z (registry time), age ~917151s >= 604800s - the seven-complete-day gate is ALREADY satisfied and NO age waiver is requested, authorized, or used; 3.3.18 is affected by zero of the four nanoid GHSA advisories (28wg-ghj8-5hjv <3.3.16, 2v37-7h3g-55p8 <3.3.18, mwcw-c2x4-8c55 <3.3.8, qrpm-p2h7-hrv2 <3.1.31). Minimum lockfile delta only (version/resolved/integrity for node_modules/nanoid, integrity sha512-DTg4MJbGMWkfi6VZFdNt2/caMbQy4Ou+Op/hJQvGEWcnVfoA1QA+xzRKAzw9jD6+GVOOeYr/mIcuDSdug6F6+w== verified against registry.npmjs.org); no direct dependency added, no broad upgrade, no unrestricted npm audit fix, unrelated package-manager churn reverted by targeted edits (never git reset/clean). Full policy run: npm ci; npm audit --audit-level=low; audit JSON total == 0; scripts/dependency_age_gate.mjs on the committed lock; registry integrity verification; npm CLI advisory verification; applicable web lint/typecheck/build/unit/E2E. One producer (orchestrator); after the frozen implementation commit, independent read-only security-reviewer (G5) and qa-engineer (G4) in parallel. PR targets main directly from origin/main 5c71fe0e08c8717cc20ac232d8bd0d8a328525e1 (deliberately unstacked: closes the failing web-dependency-security gate for every branch; PR #222 then inherits green untouched). No merge; no control-branch update; no supervisor/controller change; no A1 restart. CONTRACT CORRECTION (pre-submit, npm-ci fail-closed evidence): the repo's own exact-pin policy (M0-T019 FE-S10) pins the transitive in apps/web/package.json overrides {'nanoid': '3.3.17'}; npm ci refuses the lock-only bump ('Missing: nanoid@3.3.17 from lock file'), proving the override line is PART of the minimum required change. allowed_paths therefore includes apps/web/package.json for that single override value only (3.3.17 -> 3.3.18); an override is the policy's exact-pin mechanism, NOT a direct application dependency (D-015-R012 untouched); every other package.json byte must remain unchanged.
business_reason: B-019: the inherited nanoid 3.3.17 advisory fails the blocking web-dependency-security gate on every branch including PR #222 and origin/main; this repair restores a green dependency gate repo-wide under the permanent policy with zero waivers.
